newsitem.title: USA: Dow index off more than 50 points.
newsitem.headline: Dow index off more than 50 points.

text.p: The Dow Jones industrial average was off more than 50 points in mid-morning trading Thursday, consolidating its recent big gains made on Federal Reserve Chairman Alan Greenspan's upbeat comments about the economy.
At 10:44 a.m. EDT, the Dow was off 51.10 points at 8,037.26, which activated the New York Stock Exchange's limits on program trading.
